rationale: Values are style-code shaped (WID-4401) and unique per row; identifies the sellable item, not the design. R4.2: schema description for productIdentifier says 'unique product identifier at the level set by the delegated act'.

sample_values: Canvas Tote Bag | Canvas Tote Bag | Canvas Backpack
rationale: Repeats across rows that differ only by shade ('Canvas Tote Bag' twice, two shades). Constant across variants is the family test. R4.1: more specific than a generic description field.
Sand / Charcoal are colour names. Direct match, R3.4.
Holds 'Nos' — a unit of measure for stock counting. R3.2: a unit is not a quantity, and the CDM has no field for a counting unit. R2.2 applies: operationally real, outside the CDM.
Holds 1/0 — a boolean flag meaning 'this item is serial-tracked'. R3.1: a flag is not a value. It is not serialNumber, which would hold an actual serial.
Decimal weights in kg, column name states the unit. Maps to netWeight. Note the unit lives in the header here rather than in a separate column, so R3.2 does not bite.
ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (LK, IN). Header abbreviation is uninformative but the values are decisive. R3.4: decide on contents, not resemblance.

sample_values: Hand wash only | Hand wash only | Hand wash only
rationale: 'Hand wash only' is a care instruction. ESPR Annex III 1(f) covers instructions for use; the CDM field careInstructions is the apparel reading of that point.
Opaque internal identifier (q7x-001), no CDM counterpart. R2.1: recorded explicitly as NO_MAPPING rather than omitted, so the system pays for mapping it wrongly.
